shortDescription: Brazil's benchmark stock index Bovespa BMFBOVESPA:IBOV on Monday jumped the most since March 2020, and the real currency rallied after senator Flavio Bolsonaro unexpectedly led President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in the first round of elections.
